title: 肺功能年降400ml：药物让它涨98ml，衰老时钟逆转意味着什么？
speaker: Alex Zhavoronkov

segments.en: What is important about this drug and about in silicao in general is that most of our drugs, including this one, are discovered using aging research.
segments.zh: 关于这款药物以及英矽智能，重要的是我们大多数药物（包括这款）都是通过衰老研究发现的。

segments.en: So instead of thinking about the disease first, we think about aging, the process that everybody on the planet has, including you and I,
segments.zh: 因此，我们不是先考虑疾病，而是先考虑衰老——这个地球上每个人都经历的过程，包括你和我。

segments.en: and as probably my biggest problem and potentially your biggest problem. So we try to target that process and then purpose the drug towards the disease, where
segments.zh: 衰老可能是我最大的问题，也可能是你最大的问题。所以我们试图针对这一过程，然后将药物用于疾病治疗，

segments.en: we can potentially test the intervention. And IPF is a chronic disease that affects the elderly. So the average age of onset is about 65.
segments.zh: 我们可以在疾病中测试干预效果。特发性肺纤维化（IPF）是一种影响老年人的慢性病，平均发病年龄约为65岁。

segments.en: And we've measured forced valve capacity in this particular study, in addition to aging clocks, of course, which is kind of the way to measure long function
segments.zh: 在这项研究中，除了衰老时钟，我们还测量了用力肺活量，这是衡量肺功能的一种方式，

segments.en: as how much AR can you breathe out of your lungs. And in normal people up to 65, you also see a decline, usually it's 20 to 50 milliliters a year.
segments.zh: 即你能从肺中呼出多少空气。在65岁以下的正常人中，肺功能也会下降，通常每年下降20至50毫升。

segments.en: In IPF patients, it could be up to 400 milliliters. So here we first demonstrated that we can potentially very promising trend, reverse the forced valve capacity
segments.zh: 而IPF患者可能高达400毫升。在这里，我们首次证明，我们有可能逆转用力肺活量的下降，这是一个非常有希望的趋势。

segments.en: decline actually increased it to 98 milliliters. And now we demonstrate that the aging clocks are also taking backwards, which is very promising trend. And now we can basically say that this entire philosophy, aging first discovery to clinical trial using aging clocks is promising.
segments.zh: 实际上增加了98毫升。现在我们证明衰老时钟也在逆转，这是非常有希望的趋势。现在我们可以说，整个“衰老优先”的理念——从发现到利用衰老时钟进行临床试验——是有希望的。
